# Vicentina EMS - AI Agent Reference Guide

## Project Overview
Static multilingual website for EMS Alentejo (ems-alentejo.pt) - a personal training studio using EMS (Electro Muscle Stimulation) technology in São Teotónio, Portugal.

**Stack**: Vanilla HTML/CSS/JS + Node.js build scripts
- No frameworks, no bundlers, no runtime dependencies beyond Node.js for build
- 7 languages supported: en, pt, fr, de, nl, uk, ru

---

## ⚠️ CRITICAL: NEVER EDIT GENERATED FILES

**ALL localized HTML files in `en/`, `pt/`, `fr/`, `de/`, `nl/`, `uk/`, `ru/` folders AND the `publish/` folder are BUILD ARTIFACTS.**

### What happens if you edit generated files:
1. Your changes will be **LOST** on next `npm run build`
2. The build script overwrites these files from source + translations
3. You must edit **SOURCE FILES** only (see below)

### Source files to edit:
| File Type | Path | Purpose |
|-----------|------|---------|
| **HTML Source** | `index.html`, `ems-training.html` | Root English templates with `data-key` attributes |
| **Translations** | `resource/{lang}.json` | ALL user-facing text for all 7 languages |
| **Styles** | `css/main.css` | All styling |
| **JS** | `js/main.js` | Language switcher, cookies |
| **SEO** | `sitemap.xml`, `robots.txt` | Search engine config |

### Generated files (NEVER EDIT):
- `en/`, `pt/`, `fr/`, `de/`, `nl/`, `uk/`, `ru/` — generated by `build.js`
- `publish/` — generated by `publish.js` (deployment output)

## What to Edit (Source Files) - DETAILED

### 1. Content & Translations
**Primary: `resource/{lang}.json`** - All user-facing text lives here
- Each language has its own JSON file
- Keys use `data-key` attributes in HTML
- Add new keys here, then add `data-key="new_key"` to HTML

### 2. HTML Structure
**Source pages (EDIT THESE):**
- `index.html` - Homepage source
- `ems-training.html` - Training info page source

**How translation works:**
- HTML uses `data-key="translation_key"` attributes
- `build.js` reads source HTML + JSON → generates `lang/index.html` & `lang/ems-training.html`
- Meta tags: `<meta data-key="meta_description" content="...">`
- Element content: `<h1 data-key="hero_title">...</h1>`
- Title tag: `<title data-key="page_title">...</title>`

### 3. Styles
- `css/main.css` - All styling, responsive design, language switcher dropdown

### 4. Client-side JS
- `js/main.js` - Language detection from URL path (`/en/`, `/pt/`, etc.)
- Cookie-based language persistence
- No i18n library - relies on pre-built HTML from `build.js`

### 5. SEO
- `sitemap.xml` - Manually maintained with all 16 URLs (root + 7 languages × 2 pages)
- `robots.txt` - Basic allow all

## What is GENERATED (Never Edit Directly)

### Language Folders (created by `npm run build`)
```
en/index.html, en/ems-training.html
pt/index.html, pt/ems-training.html
... (all 7 languages)
```

These are **build artifacts** - they will be overwritten on next `npm run build`.

### Publish Folder (created by `npm run publish`)
```
publish/
├── index.html          # Root English (copied from root)
├── ems-training.html   # Root English (copied from root)
├── en/                 # Copied from en/
├── pt/                 # Copied from pt/
└── ... (all 7 languages)
```

This is the **deployment output** - upload this folder to production.

---

## Build & Deploy Commands

```bash
npm run build     # Generates language folders from source + translations
npm run publish   # Creates publish/ folder ready for deployment
```

**Workflow:**
1. Edit source files (`index.html`, `ems-training.html`, `resource/*.json`, `css/main.css`, `js/main.js`)
2. Run `npm run build` → generates `en/`, `pt/`, etc. folders
3. Run `npm run publish` → creates `publish/` folder
4. Deploy `publish/` contents to web server

## Translation System Deep Dive

### JSON Structure (`resource/en.json`)
```json
{
  "nav_home": "Home",
  "page_title": "EMS Training in São Teotónio | Ems Alentejo",
  "meta_description": "...",
  "meta_keywords": "...",
  "og_title": "...",
  "hero_title": "Book<br>Your<br>Session<br>",
  "tech_title": "The Technology of EMS",
  "about_us_p": "At Ems Alentejo, we...",
  ...
}
```

### HTML Usage
```html
<!-- Meta tags -->
<meta name="description" content="..." data-key="meta_description">
<meta property="og:title" content="..." data-key="og_title">

<!-- Element text (supports HTML in translation) -->
<h1 data-key="hero_title">Book Your Session</h1>

<!-- Title tag -->
<title data-key="page_title">Default Title</title>

<!-- Links: data-key on text node -->
<a href="#contact" data-key="nav_contact">Contact</a>
```

### Adding New Translations
1. Add key/value to `resource/en.json`
2. Copy key to all other `resource/{lang}.json` with translation
3. Add `data-key="new_key"` to HTML element
4. Run `npm run build`

## Language Detection & Routing

### URL Structure
- Root (default English): `https://ems-alentejo.pt/index.html`
- Language subfolders: `https://ems-alentejo.pt/en/`, `/pt/`, `/fr/`, etc.
- Language + page: `https://ems-alentejo.pt/en/ems-training.html`

### Client-side (`js/main.js`)
```js
// Detects language from URL path: /en/, /pt/, etc.
function getActiveLanguage() {
  const folderMatch = window.location.pathname.match(/^\/([a-z]{2})\//);
  if (folderMatch && supportedLangs.includes(folderMatch[1])) {
    return folderMatch[1];
  }
  return 'en';
}

// Switches language by navigating to localized URL
function setLanguage(lang) {
  // Navigates to /{lang}/index.html or /{lang}/ems-training.html
}
```

## Key Patterns & Conventions

### SEO Meta Tags (in all pages)
```html
<meta name="description" content="..." data-key="meta_description">
<meta property="og:title" content="..." data-key="og_title">
<meta property="og:description" content="..." data-key="meta_description">
<meta property="og:url" content="https://ems-alentejo.pt/...">
<link rel="canonical" href="https://ems-alentejo.pt/...">
```

### Language Alternates (in sitemap.xml & HTML head)
```html
<link rel="alternate" hreflang="en" href="https://ems-alentejo.pt/en/index.html">
<link rel="alternate" hreflang="pt" href="https://ems-alentejo.pt/pt/index.html">
<link rel="alternate" hreflang="x-default" href="https://ems-alentejo.pt/en/index.html">
```

### Translation Keys Naming
- `nav_*` - Navigation items
- `hero_*` - Hero section
- `tech_*` - Technology section
- `benefit_card_*_h4/p` - Benefit cards
- `about_us_*` - About section
- `services_*` - Services/pricing
- `contact_*` - Contact section
- `ems_page_*` - Training page specific
- `faq_*` - FAQ section

## Common Tasks

### Change Text Across All Languages
1. Edit `resource/en.json`
2. Copy to other 6 language files with translations
3. `npm run build && npm run publish`

### Add New Page
1. Create `new-page.html` (source)
2. Add translations to all `resource/{lang}.json`
3. Add to `sourceFiles` array in `build.js` and `publish.js`
4. Add to `sitemap.xml` for all languages
5. `npm run build && npm run publish`

### Update Styles
1. Edit `css/main.css`
2. `npm run build && npm run publish` (copies CSS to publish)

### Fix Translation Bug
- Check `build.js` regex patterns for meta tags, title, element content
- Common issue: multiline content in meta tags, special chars in JSON

---

## Troubleshooting

| Issue | Cause | Fix |
|-------|-------|-----|
| Translations not showing | `data-key` mismatch | Check key spelling in HTML vs JSON |
| Meta tags not translated | Multiline content | `build.js` handles this with `[\s\S]` regex |
| Language switch broken | Wrong URL path | Ensure generated files in `/{lang}/` folders |
| Build fails | Missing translation file | All 7 languages must have JSON in `resource/` |
| Publish missing files | Build not run first | Always run `npm run build` before `npm run publish` |

## Technologies Summary

| Layer | Technology |
|-------|------------|
| HTML | Vanilla HTML5, semantic markup |
| CSS | Vanilla CSS3, Flexbox/Grid, custom properties |
| JS | Vanilla ES6+, DOM API, cookies |
| Build | Node.js (fs, path) - custom script |
| i18n | Pre-build static generation (no runtime i18n) |
| Deployment | Static files to any web server (Apache, Nginx, Netlify, etc.) |
| Domain | CNAME: ems-alentejo.pt |

---

## Performance Notes

- No build step in production - serves pre-generated static HTML
- All translations baked into HTML at build time
- No JavaScript framework overhead
- CSS is single file, cacheable
- Images in `img/` - consider WebP/AVIF for production
- Language switching = full page navigation (not SPA)
